intro: Plain, countable things to do. Nothing here is health advice.

ideas.text: Walk for 20 minutes on five days this week
Stretch for five minutes every morning for a week
Be in bed by 11 pm on five nights this week
Cook dinner at home four nights this week
Drink a glass of water with every meal for a week
Walk or jog a 5 km route from start to finish
Take the stairs every time for one week
Do three workouts this week, any kind
Charge my phone outside the bedroom for seven nights

intro: Jobs with a clear end, so you know when to tick them off.

ideas.text: Empty and sort the junk drawer
Fill one bag with things to give away and drop it off
Fix the one broken thing I keep walking past
Deep-clean one room from top to bottom
Sort the paper pile: file, scan or recycle every sheet
Take out every piece of clothing I haven't worn in a year
Back up my photos to a second place
Repot my plants, or get my first one
Get my email inbox under 20 messages

intro: Habits and tidy-ups only. Nothing here is financial advice.

ideas.text: Write down everything I spend for seven days
Cancel one subscription I don't use
Get through one weekend without spending anything
List every recurring bill and its due date on one page
Sell three things I no longer need
Pack lunch every workday for a week
Compare prices for one bill and decide whether to switch
Put the same small amount aside every day for two weeks
Gather this year's receipts and documents into one folder

intro: Small enough to finish, big enough to notice.

ideas.text: Finish one book I've already started
Complete one full module of a course
Learn 50 words in a new language
Learn to play one song all the way through
Cook three recipes I've never tried
Practise typing for 10 minutes a day for two weeks
Learn one topic well enough to explain it to a friend, then do it
Watch one documentary and write down five things I learned
Learn ten keyboard shortcuts for the tool I use most

intro: The things that move work forward and never feel urgent.

ideas.text: Update my CV with everything from the last year
Send three job applications
Finish the task I've been putting off the longest
Publish one piece of work I'm proud of
Ask two people for honest feedback on my work
Have a conversation with someone whose job I'd like
Clear my desk and my computer desktop
Do five two-hour focus blocks with my phone in another room
Ship version one of my side project

intro: The ones that are easy to postpone for a year.

ideas.text: Call one old friend I haven't spoken to this year
Write three thank-you notes and send them
Host a meal for friends or family
Plan and keep one unhurried evening with someone I love
Have the conversation I've been avoiding
Introduce myself to a neighbour
Ask an older relative for a story and write it down
Volunteer for one shift somewhere local
Go to one club, class or meetup for the first time

intro: Finished beats perfect. Each of these has an obvious last step.

ideas.text: Finish the first draft, however rough
Draw one sketch a day for two weeks
Record one song or voice memo and play it for someone
Take a photo walk and pick my best ten shots
Build one small thing with my hands
Write 1,000 words on the thing I keep meaning to write
Plant something and keep it alive for a month
Make a one-minute video from start to finish
Write a letter by hand and post it

intro: Rest counts as a goal when you plan it and do it.

ideas.text: Write three lines in a journal every night for a week
Spend one Sunday morning with every screen off
Sit quietly for ten minutes a day for a week
Get outside before noon every day for a week
Unfollow or mute 30 accounts that don't make my day better
Plan one day trip and put it on the calendar
Read for 15 minutes before bed for a week
Say no to one thing I'd normally agree to out of habit
Take one full day off: no work, no errands
